question: Can a minimal fail-closed exact claim-to-source-span provenance contract improve evidence identity and failure localization without pretending that locator fidelity establishes semantic support or scientific authority?

included: exact quote plus optional prefix/suffix anchoring
separate externally supplied semantic evidence judgment
excluded: citation influence or causal generation attribution

prior_art_constraints: W3C Web Annotation already specifies text quote and text position selectors; selector machinery is not claimed as novel.
CLAIM-BENCH and EvidenceBench already benchmark claim/evidence linking and evidence extraction; generic claim-evidence mapping is not claimed as novel.
PaperTrail already studies claim-evidence provenance interfaces for scholarly QA; granular scholarly grounding is not claimed as novel.
Recent source-aware verification work distinguishes source ownership from pooled factual support; RAKL must keep source identity separate from semantic judgment.
RAKL candidate contribution is limited to fail-closed immutable span/source identity plus chronology and authority boundaries integrated with RAKL evidence governance.
nonblocking_meta_qois: explicit separation of locator, semantic judgment and authority

hostile_worlds.case: exact source hash, valid offsets and exact quote; no semantic judgment
actual source content differs from frozen source hash
link source hash differs from registered snapshot hash
negative or reversed text offsets
offset slice does not equal exact quote
declared prefix does not match immediate source context
declared suffix does not match immediate source context
same quote appears twice but declared offsets identify one exact occurrence
non-ASCII text indexed by Unicode code points
selector chronology explicitly says locator was frozen after semantic review/outcome
locator valid but semantic judgment absent
semantic judgment exists but known-answer validation state is unknown
semantic judgment was not frozen before downstream synthesis
semantic judgment references a different claim or evidence link
semantic judgment scope differs from frozen claim scope
proposed SUPPORTS link receives validated REFUTES review
validated semantic review returns INSUFFICIENT
exact locator plus validated pre-synthesis SUPPORTS judgment
exact locator plus validated pre-synthesis REFUTES judgment
same semantic text is copied into a different source snapshot/version
valid semantic review attempts to grant target/decision authority
identical stable inputs are evaluated repeatedly

acceptance.support_layer: All blocking meta-QoIs must pass on the frozen hostile worlds. The implementation may validate locator identity and externally supplied review records only; it must not infer entailment or grant target/scientific authority.
acceptance.real_utility: CANNOT_CHECK until a frozen real CLAIM-BENCH/EvidenceBench-like packet compares citation/source-only, exact-span provenance, and exact-span-plus-semantic-review approaches under matched model/resource/evaluator budgets.
acceptance.falsifier: If exact span provenance does not reduce wrong-source/stale-span errors or improve failure localization relative to simpler source-level citations on real scientific packets, retain it as optional audit metadata rather than mandatory decision-layer complexity.
